description: Two-component thixotropic epoxy adhesive for bonding Mapeband, Mapeband TPE, hypalon and structural bonding
whereToUse: Structural repair, bonding, and reinforcement of concrete elements, natural stone, mortar, and brick.
Structural reinforcement of beams and pillars by bonding steel (beton plaqué method) or composite material (e.g. Carboplate) plates to concrete.
Non-flexible structural bonding of precast concrete elements.
Sealing injectors and surface damage before injection of Epojet LV by the low-pressure pump.
Sealing large cracks and repairing joint corners in industrial flooring subject to traffic.
Waterproofing large-size joints by bonding TPE strips (e.g. Mapeband TPE) to concrete.
General reprofiling over large areas up to 3mm.
Filling pinholes prior to overcoating with epoxy and polyurethane flooring system.
notFor: Do not use Adesilex PG2 TG for sealing flexible joints or joints subject to movement.
Do not use Adesilex PG2 TG for shrinkage joints between fresh and hardened concrete (use Eporip).
Do not use Adesilex PG2 TG on wet surfaces.
Do not use Adesilex PG2 TG on dirty or crumbling surfaces.
Do not use Adesilex PG2 TG for bonding and grouting anti-acid ceramic tiles (use Kerapoxy).

technicalData.label: Open time (at +25°C for 24 hours and 100% R.H.) (FIP Clause 5.2)
Compressive strength at +25°C (MPa): - 12 hours: - 24 hours: - 7 days

mixing: The mixing ratio is: - 3 parts by weight of part A; - 1 part by weight of part B.
packaging: 6 kg kit (part A: 4.5 kg; part B: 1.5 kg).
storage: 24 months in their original packaging. Store the product at temperatures not below +10°C.
notes: TEMPERATURE LIMIT: this sheet says the application temperature must not be below +25°C (range from +25°C to +50°C); this is a hard limit worth showing on the page. The 20 minute pot life is stated at +50°C; no pot life is given for lower temperatures. CONSUMPTION: one figure only (1.71 kg/m² per mm of thickness), equal to the printed mass density of the mix (1.71 kg/L); no per-metre or per-joint figures are given for bonding strips or plates. Thickness limits in the text: up to 1 cm in a single layer; general reprofiling over large areas up to 3mm. PERFORMANCE TABLE: it has four columns (characteristic, test method, 'Requirement of FIP', 'Performance of product'); technicalData values for shrinkage, heat resistance, compressive strength and shear strength are from the 'Performance of product' column (FIP requirements: shrinkage ≤ 0.4, heat resistance ≥ 50°C, shear strength ≥ 12). The compressive strength row has three sub-rows and is copied as one label and one value string in the order printed: 35 MPa at 12 hours, 82 MPa at 24 hours, 89 MPa at 7 days. The reading-order text file scrambles this table, so the row-to-value pairing was taken from the layout file; the combined compressive label, the open time label and the value string '35 82 89' match the reading-order file only. STANDARDS: no EN classification is stated; the sheet only compares results with FIP clause requirements (and cites ASTM D 648 Method B as the heat resistance test method), so 'standards' is empty. The sheet uses 'part A / part B' in the text and 'component A / component B' in the table for the same things. One whereToUse example was omitted to stay within eight items: 'Bonding fibre-reinforced cement slabs and pipes.' Kit contents (4.5 kg + 1.5 kg) agree with the 3 : 1 ratio.
